name: 59870 · Stevensville, MT
findings: ZIP 59870 (Stevensville) has 48 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 59870 (Stevensville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
